title: Agent brief
description: The brief the orchestrator sends as the prompt of every agent session it starts: one JSON object on one line, built by orchestrator/core/agent_context.py (brief) and validated against this file before the session starts. It carries facts and paths only, never the content of a file: the receiver reads each named file itself. A definition or skill that describes the brief points to this file and restates none of its members.

bead.description: The id of the bead the session works for (an Epic, a Story or a Task).

inputs.description: The files the session reads, in the order the step names them. Only the files this step needs are named.

output.description: The absolute path the session writes its result to. Python validates that file against the output's contract and records it in the step journal; the session writes it there and nowhere else.

outcome.description: One line naming the result the session produces. On a corrective pass it is the instruction to correct the output named in the `validation errors` input.

request.description: What this step asks of the agent, when it asks more than the outcome says: the step's request, or else its description in the step journal.

step.description: The id of the step of the bead's step journal this session performs. A session that adds or records steps (the helper-steps.schema.json protocol) names this id as its own step.

Input.description: One file the session is handed: what it is, by label, and its absolute path.

Label.description: What an input file is. A file recorded in the step journal is handed under the name of its artifact; the labels below are the ones the agent definitions name, with what each file is.

x-labels.step journal: The bead's step journal file (step-journal.schema.json). Every brief names it last. A session reads and records artifacts in it only through `atw-step-journal`.
x-labels.validation errors: The errors Python found in the output, on a corrective pass; correct exactly those.
x-labels.prd: The PRD of the Epic. Read only the headings a pointer names (a requirement's heading, a TRD requirement's source); a definition says when the whole PRD is read.
x-labels.criteria: One repository's acceptance-criteria document. The review criteria are never handed as an input: every agent that works to them reads effective-architecture/review-standard.md through its effective-architecture skill.
x-labels.context: The architecture context file of the Epic (architecture-context.schema.json).
x-labels.architecture pack: The Epic's architecture pack, pack.json, with pack.md beside it for reading: the PRD, the Epic's reach with each entry's owner, the headings that describe it and their text, and the constraints that apply (orchestrator/flows/architecture_pack.py).
x-labels.state: The solutions architect's judgment of the state of the architecture (architecture-state.schema.json).
x-labels.findings: A result of the architecture check step that found defects for the solutions architect to correct (check-result.schema.json).
x-labels.TRD: The Epic's TRD document, as the step that confirmed it recorded it.
x-labels.request: What a helper or a design specialist is asked (specialist-request.schema.json, trd-request.schema.json or write-request.schema.json, as the receiver's definition names).
x-labels.question: A question to the architecture decider (architecture-question.schema.json).
x-labels.answer: What a helper or a design specialist returned (specialist-answer.schema.json or trd-answer.schema.json).
x-labels.write request: What the architecture maintainer is asked to write (write-request.schema.json).
x-labels.spec pack: One repository's spec pack (spec-pack.schema.json): the text of the architecture headings, the constraints and the TRD requirements its spec sessions read instead of the vault.
x-labels.span: The span file: the repositories the Epic's Stories build in (placement.schema.json).
x-labels.elements: What the Epic's Stories build, as the span step saved it (target-report.schema.json, DeltaResult).
x-labels.ui bundles: The UI bundles the owner supplied (ui-bundles.schema.json).
x-labels.ui sources: The design source of each UI item, normalized (spec-ui.schema.json).
x-labels.task gaps: What the plan of the Tasks found uncited or unsized.
x-labels.closure edges: The edges the matrix's dependency relationships make between Tasks of different Stories (closure-edges.schema.json).
x-labels.task dependency listing: Which Tasks file belongs to which Story (task-dependency-listing.schema.json).
x-labels.spec review: The review of one repository's specification documents (spec-review.schema.json).
x-labels.spec correction: An author's correction after the spec review (spec-correction.schema.json).
